NODE_ENV.description: Standard environment variable used as a fallback for environment detection if QRING_ENV is not specified.

QRING_ENV.description: Sets the current environment context for secret resolution (e.g., dev, staging, prod). This determines which value is returned when a secret exists in multiple states (Superposition).
